Fading musical everyday

ECHO SPACE — BACKGROUND

I grew up playing the violin in Qingdao. The concerts

of my childhood shaped my connection to music.

Today, that familiar musical world feels more distant.

What is lost when classical music becomes distant from

everyday life in Chinese cities?
